# mergeah_remote_mcp_connector (Resource)

Register a remote MCP connector. Changes replace the connector. Headers and auth are not returned by Merge and cannot be checked for drift. Import ID is the connector slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_remote_mcp_connector" "example" {
  name = "Support agent"
  url  = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
  slug = "support_agent"
  auth = { type = "none" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Merge API field `name`. Changes require replacement.
- `url` (String) Merge API field `url`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes, Sensitive) Merge API field `auth`. Changes require replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional headers sent to the remote server; not returned by Merge. Changes require replacement.
- `slug` (String) Connector slug; derived from its name when omitted. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Value reported by Merge: `description`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.
- `source_url` (String) Value reported by Merge: `source_url`.

### Nested Schema for `auth`

Optional:

- `header` (Attributes) Merge API field `header`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--header))

<a id="nestedatt--auth--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.header`

Required:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Merge API field `value`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_remote_mcp_connector.example 'support_agent'
```
